findings.body: A repo pinned to `v1.3.0-rc.1` still cannot run `forge upgrade v1.3.0`: `_numbers` discards the prerelease suffix, so the comparison at line 79 treats both releases as equal and refuses. Such pins are accepted by `src/forge/repo.py:142` and validated at line 286, while [semantic-version precedence](https://semver.org/#spec-item-11) makes the stable release newer. Preserve that distinction when comparing the requested release with the fetched pin. This previously reported issue remains unresolved.
findings.title: Compare prerelease pins before rejecting their stable release
